details:
1. Be in FBT mode (feet and waist, besides head and hand controllers)

2. Have holoport locomotion enabled

3. Have FBT locomotion animation enabled

4. Begin moving your avatar around (via holoport).

5. There is a semi-rare chance that your character's head (and possibly hands) will be twisted around 180 degrees, facing their back, until the holoport ends.

I have a hard time reproducing this on demand;  in a crowded room, it was happening frequently, and I suspected that it was more likely if my head was turned slightly to the side (relative to my waist) when beginning the holoport.   But when testing more carefully in an empty room, I found it only happened maybe 1 in every 20 holoports, and I didn't find any correspondence between head angle and the likelihood of the bug occurring.

When it happens, it remains that way until the holoport ends.   This bug syncs (as in, everyone else in the room saw my head twisting around disturbingly too).   It seems to be 50/50 whether only the head is backwards, or if the arms are twisted backwards as well.   Having holoport disabled SEEMS to prevent the bug (although I didn't test that very long, because it makes me queasy).   Having FBT locomotion disabled prevents the bug, seemingly.
title: Head twists backwards when holoport walking in FBT
